notablePrerequisites: Zabaz has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Zabaz, adding {C}{C}.
Zabaz dies, triggering its modular ability, moving its +1/+1 counters onto Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Zabaz on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Zabaz from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Zabaz enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.
